description: This Java source file defines a static data provider for tourist attractions in a specified city, including data structures for attractions, geofencing, and city locations.

classes.name: TouristAttractions
classes.description: A static data provider class for tourist attractions, city locations, and geofencing parameters.

methods.name: getGeofenceList
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of geofences based on city locations for geofencing triggers.

methods.name: getClosestCity
methods.description: Determines and returns the nearest city to a given latitude/longitude point.
